{"edit_description":"CREATE a brand-new single self-contained HTML file: an animated neon "synaptic network growth" simulation (~500-650 lines). No file exists yet at this path — generate the complete file from scratch.

=========== PAGE / LAYOUT ===========
- One <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="800"> centered in the viewport via CSS flexbox (100vh, align/justify center).
- Page body background exactly #05070f, plus a very subtle radial gradient glow of #101a3a behind/around the canvas.
- Canvas has a thin 1px border rgba(0,229,255,0.25) and slight border-radius.
- Minimal monospace caption above the canvas in accent color #ffd400 (e.g. "SYNAPTIC GROWTH // NEON NETWORK"), letter-spaced, tiny font. No brand/game/film references anywhere.

=========== LIBRARIES ===========
- ONLY dat.gui, loaded via CDN script tag: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js
- No other libraries, modules, frameworks, images, textures, fonts or assets. Everything inline in this one file.

=========== EXACT PALETTE (defaults) ===========
- Background: #05070f
- Background glow: #101a3a
- Main branch color: #00e5ff
- Secondary branch accent: #d6ff00
- Synapse color: #ff2bd6
- Pulse color: #fff36a
- UI/accent color: #ffd400
- Grid/scanline color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)

=========== PARAMS + dat.gui ===========
A single `params` object, wired to dat.gui with 4 folders:

Folder "Growth":
- neuronCount: slider 3–6 step 1, default 4
- growthSpeed: 0.5–6, default 2.2 (px per frame per branch tip)
- maxDepth: 3–10 step 1, default 7
- splitChance: 0–0.5, default 0.16
- curvature: 0–1, default 0.45 (random walk strength of branch angle)
- maxBranchLength: 60–350, default 190

Folder "Synapses":
- synapseDistance: 15–150, default 55 (tip-to-tip threshold)
- synapseGlow: 0–40, default 16 (shadowBlur for synapses)

Folder "Pulses":
- pulseSpeed: 0.005–0.08, default 0.025 (t increment per frame)
- pulseFrequency: 0–0.5, default 0.08 (chance per frame to spawn a pulse)
- pulseBrightness: 0.5–3, default 1.4

Folder "Visuals":
- backgroundColor: color picker, '#05070f'
- branchColor: '#00e5ff'
- accentColor: '#d6ff00'
- synapseColor: '#ff2bd6'
- pulseColor: '#fff36a'
- glowIntensity: 0–30, default 9 (branch shadowBlur)
- vignetteStrength: 0–1, default 0.55
- showGrid: boolean, default true
- showScanlines: boolean, default true

Buttons (top level or in a folder, clearly labeled):
- "regenerate network" → clears everything and grows a fresh network with current params
- "clear canvas" → wipes neurons/branches/synapses/pulses, leaves blank background
- "pause/resume animation" → toggles running flag (updates stop; label may stay fixed)

Code registers .onChange/.listen where useful (e.g. background color applies immediately).

=========== JS CODE STRUCTURE (short // ---- section ---- comments) ===========

// ---- setup ----
Canvas + ctx, params object with palette defaults, state: neurons[], synapses[], pulses[], branchCount, growing flag, time accumulator, running=true. Helper rand(a,b).

// ---- GUI setup ----
Build dat.gui as specified above.

// ---- neuron growth ----
regenerateNetwork(): spawn params.neuronCount neurons at random points within ~200px of canvas center (400,400). Each neuron: {x, y, id, branches:[], flash:0}. seedBranch(neuron, angle): create initial branches (2-3 per neuron at random angles).
Branch object: {neuron, points:[{x,y}], angle, depth, thickness (0.6–2.4, varies randomly), len, maxLen, accent (bool ~25% chance), alive:true}.
updateGrowth(): each frame, for every alive branch:
- angle += (Math.random()-0.5) * params.curvature * 0.5 → organic wander
- advance tip by params.growthSpeed px in current angle direction, push point every step (or push every N px to keep arrays small)
- len += growthSpeed
- END conditions (mark alive=false): len > maxLen (maxLen = maxBranchLength * (0.55 + random*0.45) scaled down ~15% per depth level), depth >= maxDepth, tip leaves canvas with 30px margin, or branchCount > 420 (hard cap).
- On end OR at random segment intervals while alive: with params.splitChance create 2 child branches at angle ± rand(0.3, 0.9) radians, depth+1, thickness*0.75, shorter maxLen (recursive but implemented as queue/stack so it is iterative — no deep recursion).
- Occasionally (chance ~0.035 per frame while alive) spawn ONE smaller side branch at angle ± rand(1.0, 1.6), thinner (thickness*0.6), depth+2.
Growth phase ends when no branch is alive → growing=false (stable network; scene keeps animating pulses).

// ---- synapse detection ----
Each frame during growth (and every ~30 frames after): compare TIPS (last point) of branches from DIFFERENT neurons. If distance < params.synapseDistance and no synapse already exists for that neuron pair (key = sorted "idA|idB" in a Set), create synapse {a: neuronA, b: neuronB, x1,y1,x2,y2, phase: random*2π, key}. Cap total synapses ~70. Mark both branch tips as "connected" so they stop growing toward each other naturally (optional, keep simple).

// ---- pulse animation ----
pulses[] entries: {syn, t, dir}. Each frame, if !growing or always: with probability params.pulseFrequency spawn a pulse on a random synapse, t starts 0 or 1, dir ±1. Advance t += params.pulseSpeed. Position via linear interpolation between synapse endpoints (x = lerp(x1, x2, tt)). Add tiny random perpendicular jitter (±1.5px) for electric-spark feel. When t crosses 0/1: remove pulse, set destination neuron.flash = 1 (decays each frame, drawn as brief glow). Keep max ~40 pulses.

// ---- rendering ---- (single draw() per rAF frame)
1. Fill full canvas with params.backgroundColor (opaque).
2. If showGrid: faint grid lines every 40px, strokeStyle rgba(0,229,255,0.08), lineWidth 1, batched in one path.
3. Background glow: radial gradient centered on canvas, rgba(16,26,58,0.5) → transparent, radius ~480 (draw once to offscreen canvas cached, or recompute — keep cheap).
4. Branches: for each neuron's branches, build path through points using quadraticCurveTo with midpoint smoothing (moveTo p0, then quadraticCurveTo(pi, midpoint(pi,pi+1)) style). Stroke with branchColor (or accentColor for accent branches), lineWidth = thickness, shadowColor = same color, shadowBlur = params.glowIntensity. Group strokes to limit state changes. Alpha ~0.9.
5. Somas (seed neurons): glowing filled circle radius 3.5, branchColor, shadowBlur = glowIntensity*1.6; if neuron.flash > 0 draw extra halo with flash alpha (use pulseColor for flash).
6. Synapses: line between the two tip endpoints, synapseColor, alpha = 0.35 + 0.35*sin(time*2 + phase) (soft pulsing), shadowBlur = params.synapseGlow (brighter than branches). Plus a small dot (radius 2) at the midpoint with stronger glow (synapseGlow*1.3).
7. Pulses: bright spark — circle radius ~2.5 params.pulseBrightness-scaled at interpolated position with pulseColor, shadowBlur = 10*pulseBrightness, plus a 3-4 point fading trail (previous interpolated positions at t - k*pulseSpeed*2). Reset shadowBlur=0 after.
8. Vignette: radial gradient from center transparent → rgba(5,7,15, vignetteStrength) at corners, drawn over everything (createRadialGradient radius 300→570).
9. If showScanlines: horizontal lines every 4px, rgba(0,229,255,0.03)-ish (or the 0.08 palette color at lower alpha), single path, drawn last, cheap. Optionally animate a subtle slow vertical scan band (one translucent horizontal band moving down slowly) — keep lightweight.
10. Main loop: requestAnimationFrame, time from performance.now(); if !running, skip updates AND skip redraw (freeze frame). While growing, updateGrowth + synapse detection each frame.

=========== QUALITY / PERFORMANCE ===========
- Plain arrays + lightweight object literals only. No classes needed (or minimal). No per-frame gradient creation where avoidable (vignette/bg glow can be cached, but simplicity first).
- All loops simple; caps: 420 branches, 70 synapses, 40 pulses.
- Reset shadowBlur to 0 when not glowing to avoid slowdown.
- Short comments per major section only. Compact but readable vanilla ES6. English comments.
- Do NOT mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style anywhere in code/comments — describe the look as "neon / futuristic / synaptic" only.
- Start animation automatically on load (regenerate once at startup).","path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
